With the order-free score the same NCC candidates have validation PCK8 0.81-1.00 in fold 4.
Temporal split: T1 selected r=16 m=40 (133/133); T1b selected r=32 m=40 (validation PCK8 1.00 against 0.83) and identified 129/133. The order-free selection is therefore not better in every split.
The same-hole share of T1 and T1b is 0 by construction; T2 kept 3,204 of 7,104 same-hole test images because the two per-key boxes overlap (the latch-side hole changes side with the class).
Own S of T1b is 1,474.5-1,476.6 mm in the five folds (learned detector 1,474.2-1,475.3 mm); judging the T1b detections with the learned S changes no door decision.
The stored single-thread detection times of this run were measured while 20 worker processes ran in parallel and are not reported.
